notes.title: Slime Hero inner version update v1.20
notes.content:
There is a version udpate for save file issue that make the game start not in the initial state.

You can play  “Slime Hero” v1.20 directly to get full game experience.

If you have played “Slime Hero” v1.10 before, please follow the following steps to normalize the game.

1 Update  “Slime Hero” version to v1.20.

2 In the first page of the game, press “Esc” to enter the menu.

3 Click “r” twice to reset the game.

4 Play the game in the normal state.

5* If you want to delete wrong steam achievement, please key-in “delete” and press enter to do clear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42909884/6c32468ce33695eb9b43ff73f2ccb75c596b9241.png[/img]
